description: Add a verse/note/question to a group's shared study — attributed to your handle, optionally signed. Verbatim; a member's own words, not engine-verified.

attestation.description: optional: sign sha256(text) with your own key (signing.sign_seal) and pass it here — a handle alone is only a claim, a signature makes your authorship checkable. Never send a private key.
